description: This file defines an interface for request-related exceptions in the PSR HTTP Client standard. It specifies a method to retrieve the associated request object when an exception occurs.
external_methods: Psr\Http\Message\RequestInterface::__construct() (implied, as interface definitions typically do not include constructors)

classes.name: RequestExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface that represents exceptions occurring during HTTP requests, extending ClientExceptionInterface and adding a method to retrieve the request.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request associated with the exception, which may be different from the original request object passed to the client.
